(A) Greece joins the EC
(B) Spain and Portugal join the EC
(C) Austria, Finland and Sweden join the EU
(D) The Maastricht Treaty was signed

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.
Correct answer. Accurately identifies the chronological/logical progression.
Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.
Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
NCERT Class 12 Contemporary World Politics (Chapter 4: Alternative Centres of Power, timeline box 'European Integration', p. 55): (A) Greece joins the EC in January 1981. (B) Spain and Portugal join the EC in January 1986. (D) The Treaty on European Union (Maastricht Treaty) was signed on 7 February 1992 (establishing the EU). (C) Austria, Finland, and Sweden join the EU in January 1995. Hence the chronological order is: (A) [1981] -> (B) [1986] -> (D) [1992] -> (C) [1995].
Hence, option (B) is correct.
